real_numbers.pass_hat_5_definition: fraction of instances whose ALL 5 independent runs PASSed

why_both_matter: per_attempt shows extraction ability; pass^5 shows reliability. Our 0.75 was per_attempt, mislabeled as pass^5. The 33.3% is the honest reliability estimate at 5-run consistency.
